# Random Value

Gives each splat or point a repeatable random value for varied edits.

`lfs.random_value` · Input

## How to use

Set Min and Max to the range you need.  
Change Seed for another pattern; reordering geometry can change it too.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Min | `Min` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Lowest random value, in the units you need. 0 is the default; keep it below Max. |
| Max | `Max` | lfs.float | 1 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Highest random value, in the units you need. 1 is the default; keep it above Min. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.float | — | — | Resulting number, in the units of your calculation. Connect it to a compatible numeric input. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Seed | `seed` | int | 0 | — | Whole-number seed for a repeatable pattern. 0 is the default; changing it gives a different pattern. |
